exact_arithmetic: Integer IEEE decoding and Fraction division/product/equality; no floating-point tolerance or rounding used.

older_search_domains.common_scalar: Earlier arbitrary-single-X-row search permitted one common scalar across M and targeted older BF16-visible failures, not FAIL91. It did not test this piecewise wave-dependent donor model.
older_search_domains.two_row: Earlier exhaustive two-row search DID include wave-dependent0x0810/0x0a10 donors and arbitrary k, but required second term4*X[k+8,M]. It targeted six older failures, not FAIL91.
older_search_domains.contiguous: Earlier contiguous search DID include wave-dependent donor, but its fixed block profile was X[64*b+1,M]+4*X[64*b+9,M] over cyclic contiguous intervals. It did not test one arbitrary-k term.

limits: Exact data representation, not proof of hardware causal delivery or the time of corruption.
Only even-M accumulator words are retained here. Odd-M predictions are not observed.
155 matching saved-X rows prevent unique k identification. Arithmetic matching must be constrained by independently proved WMMA lane/K mapping.
Historical donor binding uses architectural exact-packet proof; that proof does not guarantee physical hardware execution.
Rejected alternatives above fix specific donor choices. They do not exhaust all arbitrary real common scalars or multi-row sums.
